name: mateu-visual-editor
description: Visual editor for Mateu YAML pages — palette + WYSIWYG canvas + properties, in one view. Shares the exact web bundle with the IntelliJ (JCEF) host.

mateu.baseUrl.description: Mateu backend base URL (serves the reserved __preview__ / __contract__ sync actions).

scripts.copy:web: cd ../../web/monorepo/apps/visual-editor && npm run build && rm -rf ../../../../app/vscode-extension/media && mkdir -p ../../../../app/vscode-extension/media && cp -rf dist/* ../../../../app/vscode-extension/media/
